Test Case Description: Verify Direct Debit Maintenance module loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in with access to Account Utilities
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Start > Account Utilities > Direct Debit Maintenance | 2. Wait for page load completion | 3. Verify the main form, action panel, and message panel are visible
Expected Result: Direct Debit Maintenance screen loads without console errors and core sections are rendered correctly

Test Case Description: Verify default VIEW mode button states on initial load
Preconditions: Module is opened successfully
Test Steps: 1. Open Direct Debit Maintenance | 2. Observe View, Add, Edit, Delete, Stop, Print, Save, and Cancel buttons
Expected Result: View and Add are available for a new session, while Edit, Delete, Stop, Print, and Save remain disabled until a record is loaded

Test Case Description: Verify form fields are read-only in VIEW mode
Preconditions: Module is opened successfully
Test Steps: 1. Open Direct Debit Maintenance | 2. Try typing into editable-looking fields before clicking Add or Edit
Expected Result: Inputs, selects, textareas, and lookup buttons remain disabled in VIEW mode except the Direct Debit Instruction lookup used for loading records

Test Case Description: Verify section headers collapse and expand their content
Preconditions: Module is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click each section header once to collapse the content | 2. Click again to expand it
Expected Result: Section content toggles correctly and the chevron icon plus aria-expanded state are updated consistently

Test Case Description: Verify refresh clears the form when no record is loaded
Preconditions: Module is opened with no record currently loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click the window refresh action | 2. Observe the form state
Expected Result: The form remains cleared, audit labels stay at default placeholders, and the module stays in VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify branch lookup search and selection
Preconditions: User switches the module to Add mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Click the Branch lookup icon | 3. Search for a valid branch | 4. Select a branch
Expected Result: Selected branch ID and branch name populate the Branch fields correctly

Test Case Description: Verify account lookup is filtered by selected branch
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode and a valid Branch ID is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click the Account lookup icon | 2. Search for accounts | 3. Select a result
Expected Result: Account lookup uses the selected branch as a filter and fills Account ID and Account Name with the chosen account

Test Case Description: Verify currency lookup populates transaction currency fields
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Click the Transaction Currency lookup icon | 2. Search for a valid currency | 3. Select a row
Expected Result: Currency ID and currency description are populated in the transaction currency fields

Test Case Description: Verify contra bank lookup resets contra branch context
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode and a Contra Branch was previously selected
Test Steps: 1. Select a Contra Bank | 2. Observe Contra Branch fields after bank selection
Expected Result: Contra Bank ID and name are populated and existing Contra Branch ID and name are cleared to avoid stale branch context

Test Case Description: Verify contra branch lookup is filtered by selected contra bank
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode and a valid Contra Bank ID is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click the Contra Branch lookup icon | 2. Search and choose a branch
Expected Result: Contra Branch lookup uses the selected bank as a filter and fills Contra Branch ID and name correctly

Test Case Description: Verify Direct Debit Instruction lookup is available in VIEW mode
Preconditions: Module is in VIEW mode
Test Steps: 1. Click the Direct Debit Instruction lookup icon | 2. Search for an existing instruction | 3. Select a record
Expected Result: Lookup remains enabled in VIEW mode and selecting a record triggers loading of the selected direct debit instruction

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads a record using entered instruction ID
Preconditions: An existing Direct Debit Instruction ID is known
Test Steps: 1. Type a valid Direct Debit Instruction ID | 2. Click View | 3. Review all sections
Expected Result: Persisted values load into the form, the module returns to VIEW mode, and a success message is shown

Test Case Description: Verify View action warns when no instruction ID is provided
Preconditions: No record is loaded and Direct Debit Instruction ID is blank
Test Steps: 1. Open the module fresh | 2. Click View
Expected Result: System clears the form, stays in VIEW mode, and shows a warning instructing the user to enter a Direct Debit Instruction ID

Test Case Description: Verify Add action clears the form and enables entry
Preconditions: Module is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Inspect form fields and button states
Expected Result: Form is cleared, editable controls and lookups become enabled, Save and Cancel are active, and the module enters ADD mode

Test Case Description: Create a new direct debit instruction with valid data
Preconditions: User is in Add mode with access to valid branch, account, currency, frequency, and contra details
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Enter valid direct debit details including branch, account, instruction type, amount, dates, frequency, and contra details | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Record is created successfully, a success message is shown, and the saved record can be reloaded in VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify save payload uses default Amount Type ID of T
Preconditions: Browser network tools are available and user is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Save a direct debit record | 2. Inspect the save request payload
Expected Result: Payload includes AmountTypeID or amountTypeId with the default value T when no alternate amount type is set in the UI

Test Case Description: Verify loaded record maps status code to friendly status text
Preconditions: An existing record with a status code such as A, I, S, P, or C exists
Test Steps: 1. Load the record | 2. Observe the Standing Instruction Status field
Expected Result: Status field displays the mapped friendly text such as Active, Inactive, Stopped, Pending, or Cancelled instead of the raw code when applicable

Test Case Description: Verify API dates are normalized into HTML date inputs
Preconditions: An existing record contains Effective Date, First Execution Date, Last Execution Date, or Value Date from the backend
Test Steps: 1. Load the record | 2. Inspect all date inputs
Expected Result: Returned dates are normalized into valid yyyy-MM-dd input values and displayed correctly in the date controls

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action requires a loaded record
Preconditions: No direct debit record is currently loaded
Test Steps: 1. Open the module fresh | 2. Attempt to click Edit if available
Expected Result: Edit is not available until a record is loaded, preventing record locking and edits on empty context

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action acquires a record lock before enabling edits
Preconditions: An existing direct debit instruction is loaded in VIEW mode
Test Steps: 1. Load a valid record | 2. Click Edit | 3. Monitor the add lock API call or system behavior
Expected Result: System attempts to add a record lock using Branch ID, Module ID, and PKKey before switching the form into EDIT mode

Test Case Description: Edit an existing direct debit instruction and save changes
Preconditions: An existing direct debit instruction is loaded and lock acquisition succeeds
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Change editable fields such as amount, frequency, or remarks | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Record updates successfully, success feedback is shown, and the latest values are visible after the record reloads

Test Case Description: Verify Cancel in Edit mode releases the record lock and reloads data
Preconditions: A record is loaded, Edit mode is active, and unsaved changes exist
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Change one or more values | 3. Click Cancel | 4. Confirm cancellation if prompted
Expected Result: System releases the record lock, discards unsaved changes, and reloads the last viewed persisted record

Test Case Description: Verify Cancel in Add mode discards unsaved data and returns to VIEW mode
Preconditions: User is in Add mode with unsaved values entered
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Enter sample values | 3. Click Cancel | 4. Confirm cancellation if prompted
Expected Result: Unsaved values are discarded and the module returns to a clean VIEW state

Test Case Description: Delete an existing direct debit instruction with confirmation
Preconditions: An existing direct debit instruction is loaded and user has delete rights
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Click Delete | 3. Confirm the delete dialog
Expected Result: Delete API is executed successfully, success feedback is shown, and the form is cleared back to VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify delete is cancelled when the user declines confirmation
Preconditions: An existing direct debit instruction is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete | 2. Choose No or Cancel in the confirmation dialog
Expected Result: No delete API call is made and the current record remains loaded unchanged

Test Case Description: Stop an existing direct debit instruction successfully
Preconditions: An existing active direct debit instruction is loaded and record lock acquisition succeeds
Test Steps: 1. Load an active record | 2. Click Stop | 3. Confirm the stop dialog
Expected Result: System adds a record lock, calls the stop API, reloads the record, and shows a success message

Test Case Description: Verify stop flow always releases the record lock after processing
Preconditions: A stop attempt is made on a loaded record
Test Steps: 1. Click Stop and confirm | 2. Observe the release lock API behavior after success or failure
Expected Result: Release lock is attempted after the stop process completes so the record is not left locked by the current session

Test Case Description: Verify print action opens browser print flow for a loaded record
Preconditions: An existing direct debit instruction is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Click Print
Expected Result: Browser print flow is triggered using the current form view without changing record data

Test Case Description: Verify refresh reloads the currently loaded record
Preconditions: An existing direct debit instruction is already loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Click the refresh action | 3. Observe field values and messages
Expected Result: System reloads the current record using the saved search key and refreshes displayed values

Test Case Description: Verify close action prompts when unsaved changes exist
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode with unsaved changes
Test Steps: 1. Modify one or more fields | 2. Click the window close action
Expected Result: System prompts for confirmation before closing or redirecting because unsaved changes are present

Test Case Description: Verify audit and execution metadata render for a loaded record
Preconditions: An existing record contains audit and execution metadata
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Expand Behind The Scene | 3. Review Next Execution Date, Last Run Date, Created By, Modified By, and related fields
Expected Result: Audit and execution fields display returned values or the default placeholder when data is absent, and remain read-only

Test Case Description: Verify unauthorized session is handled gracefully by the API flow
Preconditions: User session is expired or user is not authenticated
Test Steps: 1. Open the module or attempt View, Save, Delete, or Stop after session expiry | 2. Observe response handling
Expected Result: Backend returns unauthorized response and the user receives failure feedback instead of silent success

Test Case Description: Verify message and loading indicators during long-running operations
Preconditions: Module is loaded and an operation such as View, Save, Delete, or Stop is triggered
Test Steps: 1. Trigger a data operation | 2. Observe the loading overlay and resulting message area or notification
Expected Result: Loading overlay appears while the request is in progress and user feedback is shown after completion

Test Case Description: Verify direct debit lookup selection also populates description text
Preconditions: The Direct Debit Instruction lookup contains valid rows
Test Steps: 1. Open the Direct Debit Instruction lookup | 2. Select a record
Expected Result: Instruction ID is filled and the adjacent description field is populated using Account Name, Reference No, or description from the selected row
